subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in core delivery mode that coalesces or final-only-delivers assistant text across tool-interleaved agent turns, and which agents/channel config shape should own it?
rationale: The source-backed UX problem is real, but the fix adds delivery policy and configuration surface that changes channel semantics and overlaps suppression and ordering issues.

options.title: Add opt-in coalescing/final-only mode
options.body: Define a narrow agents or channel delivery setting that preserves metadata and covers streamed and final payload paths with regression tests.

options.title: Keep current visible boundaries
options.body: Preserve pre-tool/message boundaries and direct users toward prompt discipline, explicit message-tool semantics, or narrower suppression fixes.

options.title: Split delivery policies
options.body: Handle one-message coalescing, suppression, and Discord ordering as separate maintainer decisions so one fix does not choose a broad default by accident.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in coalescing/final-only mode
recommendation.body: Define a narrow agents or channel delivery setting that preserves metadata and covers streamed and final payload paths with regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current and historical signal across reply coalescing, streaming docs, and related product review.
